title: Ctrl-G: Controlling Structural and Interaction Exposure in Knowledge Graph Augmented LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.08739v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide structured evidence for Web question answering with large language models (LLMs), but sending retrieved evidence to a remote LLM can expose sensitive graph information. Existing privacy treatments use entity anonymization and relation-centric abstraction to preserve reasoning cues, but transmitted topology remains visible and disclosure accumulates across repeated calls. Distinctive topology can support re-identification of masked entities (structural exposure), while successive calls accumulate additional paths and exploration traces into a broader view of the KG (interaction exposure). Simply sending less evidence is insufficient because restricted, stepwise views may omit the bridge paths required for multi-hop reasoning. translated_title: Ctrl-G：在知识图谱增强的LLM推理中控制结构暴露与交互暴露
translated_abstract: 知识图谱（KG）为基于大语言模型（LLM）的网络问答提供了结构化证据，但将检索到的证据发送至远程LLM可能会暴露敏感的图信息。现有的隐私处理方法采用实体匿名化和以关系为中心的抽象来保留推理线索，但所传输的拓扑结构仍然可见，且信息披露会随多次调用不断累积。独特的拓扑结构可能支持对被掩码实体的重识别（即结构暴露），而连续多次调用会累积额外的路径和探索痕迹，从而形成对知识图谱更全面的视图（即交互暴露）。仅仅发送更少的证据是不够的，因为受限的、分步的视图可能会遗漏多跳推理所需的桥接路径。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Ctrl-G，据我们所知，这是首个能够联合控制向远程LLM暴露的结构与交互信息、同时支持……（原文摘要在此处截断）的KG-RAG框架。
tldr: 提出Ctrl-G，这是首个能联合控制知识图谱增强LLM推理中结构暴露（拓扑信息）与交互暴露（多次调用累积信息）的隐私保护KG-RAG框架，同时保留多跳推理所需的桥接路径。
en_tdlr: Ctrl-G is proposed as the first KG-RAG privacy-preserving framework that jointly controls both structural exposure (topology) and interaction exposure (accumulated information across repeated calls) to remote LLMs, while preserving the bridge paths required for multi-hop reasoning.
